name: 実践のあとに気持ちを振り返る
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0024「実践のあとに気持ちを振り返る」. ONE Japanese post-practice reflection component.
Image1 ORIGINAL Headspace controls option-button anatomy, optical weight/proportions, alignment, spacing and visible UNSELECTED state. Scope ONLY logical x0,y300,w390,h365, question/subtitle/four choices; the orange/yellow illustration and back/close controls above are OUTSIDE this component. Image2 our mock is SECONDARY for Japanese content, saved typography and layout. Its broad mint-filled options are not final authority. Image3 bus STYLE ONLY for white surfaces, fine neutral borders and restrained soft depth.
Pure white canvas, no outer enclosing card or artwork. Centered exact heading「やってみて、どうでしたか？」, below it centered subtitle「少しだけ振り返ってみましょう。」. Then four evenly spaced full-width rounded pill buttons in source order, each with centered Japanese text:
1「落ち着くことができた」
2「難しかったけれど、続けたい」
3「少し気持ちが沈んでいる」
4「まだ、よく分からない」
All four choices are equally available and UNSELECTED, as original. White button surfaces, subtle neutral outline and small soft downward shadow. Do not fill one green, add checkmarks, add icons, invent selected state or use green/mint button fills. No separate submit/next button. Preserve complete text; wrap only if necessary without shrinking.
Typography locked native: heading Meiryo Bold20px/28px; subtitle and ALL option labels Meiryo Regular14px/24px; letter spacing0. Heading/labels ink#1D1D1D, subtitle#6E6E6E. Compact readable vertical rhythm, logical width390 and overall365ish height. Heading fully visible, not clipped at top as in rough mock. Gentle pill corners and usable target heights.
Accent decision: source orange/yellow is artwork above scope; option warm tint has no selected-state meaning. Use official white surfaces and neutral text/borders, no forced brand-green action because these are equal unselected choices. No decorative artwork, colored icon, broad tint, gloss, glow, device frame or watermark. Raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: Heading/subtitle and four Japanese choice strings inspected and complete. All options remain equally unselected with white surfaces, fine neutral borders/soft shadows; mock broad mint removed. Correct hierarchy of bold heading and regular body/options; no extra art/control/selected state or clipping. Original illustration lies outside scope. Native exact font metrics and real selection behavior unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
